profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Applied Materials
profile.summary: I love programming and learning new technologies. Making useful software products is what I always try to accomplish.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and supported the Prizm software platform which composes of Angular in front end, Python for API, and MariaDB for database:
- Led the team in the effort of migrating database from MySQL to MariaDB. Redesigned and optimized the code to work well with MariaDB. Supported customers and remote engineers with bugs post migration.
- Added features to the Prizm software that enable engineers at semiconductor fabrication plants to inspect the products better and adjust formula to have better yield.
- Converted the team development environment from server to local machine using Docker.
- Contributed to the project of switching Prizm software platform from using AngularJS to React for front end.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
DNS Software engineer: maintain and implement new features for Limelight Networks’s API driven DNS system. Contribute to UI/UX and backend design decision to provide fast and efficient DNS system. 
-UI/UX design experience from revamping the web front-end which let user manages DNS records using AngularJS. 
-Backend design experience from implementing the diff tool in the API to show different between the old and new DNS records (similar to Github) when it gets updated using Python diff library and Django Rest Framework. 
-Speed and security optimization experience from designing database migration tool that merged Limelight old DNS system with newer system using Python, Flask, and MySQL. 
-Gaining experience working with Docker containers for development and testing purposes.

positions.title: Intern IP Core Operation Analyst
positions.description:
Performed network engineer’s tasks such as traffic monitor, configure network equipment, and update configuration to the latest standard.  
-Worked to maintain data integrity on Limelight Networks internal site and circuit database 
-Learned speed optimization from working with large amount of IP addresses from assisting relocating IP address block more efficient by designing and developing Python scripts to audit Limelight Network's global IP address usage 
-Assisted on the global implementation of standards on the Limelight CDN network 
-Helped internal management software working together by detecting and eliminating more than 80% of network old-format interface configuration

positions.title: Mathematics and Computer Science Stutor
positions.description:
-Tutor all Calculus levels: helping students solve problems and gain independent learning habit.
-Tutor all CS courses at Mesa Community College from introduction classes to Data structure with C++, Java
-Helping CS students track down syntax, logical error and debug code.
-Helping student design and understand algorithm as well as how to translate ideas to code.
-Explaining programming projects and data structures

projects.title: Cornerstone
projects.description:
Cornerstone is a database that stores all the information of the devices(routers, switches) that own by Limelight Network. This database replaces the traditional drawing and PDF files. Cornerstone offers engineer a powerful tool to check for configuration and fixing issue quickly. 
-Fixing label of routers and switches.
-Removing extra ethernet ports and adding missing ethernet ports
-Fixing ethernet ports that have wrong connected devices
-Adding network circuit to missing devices
